mapper.select:
select usage_id, user_id, user_name, device_id, provider_id, provider_name, model, input_tokens, output_tokens, estimated, status, error, duration_ms, created_at from itm_llm_usage
order by usage_id desc

select user_name as userName, provider_name as providerName, model, count(*) as requests, sum(case when status = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as failures, sum(input_tokens) as inputTokens, sum(output_tokens) as outputTokens, max(created_at) as lastUsedAt from itm_llm_usage
group by user_name, provider_name, model order by sum(input_tokens) + sum(output_tokens) desc
select ifnull(sum(input_tokens + output_tokens), 0) from itm_llm_usage where user_id = #{userId} and created_at >= #{since}
mapper.insert: insert into itm_llm_usage (user_id, user_name, device_id, provider_id, provider_name, model, input_tokens, output_tokens, estimated, status, error, duration_ms, created_at) values (#{userId}, ifnull(#{userName}, ''), ifnull(#{deviceId}, ''), #{providerId}, ifnull(#{providerName}, ''), ifnull(#{model}, ''), ifnull(#{inputTokens}, 0), ifnull(#{outputTokens}, 0), ifnull(#{estimated}, '0'), #{status}, ifnull(#{error}, ''), ifnull(#{durationMs}, 0), #{createdAt})
mapper.delete: delete from itm_llm_usage where created_at < #{before} limit #{limit}
